author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing tipped the torso into a crouch with the head floating off to the side over a flat arm, and the discus sat against the head. The original is an upright wind-up: head centred over the torso, discus held high behind on a bent arm, free arm raised on the far side, wide stance.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Upright thrower with a centred head, discus held back on a bent arm, free arm raised, wide stance; matches the reference.
omissions: None beyond the stick-figure reduction of the body outline.
lucide_reference: No direct Lucide match; stick figure from full_body_ref.png.
